# Scouting report: Prairie
_2016 possessions over 21 games; 96 from tracking; 1 labels corrected by analysts._

## Early Clock (755 possessions, confidence high)
- Lead play: **transition** 33% (95%: 30% to 36%), lift 2.0x against their overall habit, 0.931 points per possession
- Clips: 99.9s to 104.9s, 505.7s to 511.4s, 586.6s to 592.8s

## Mid Clock (743 possessions, confidence high)
- Lead play: **isolation** 28% (95%: 25% to 32%), lift 1.18x against their overall habit, 1.014 points per possession
- Clips: 216.8s to 226.5s, 271.1s to 280.9s, 425.8s to 437.2s

## Late Clock (518 possessions, confidence high)
- Lead play: **pick and roll** 37% (95%: 33% to 41%), lift 1.52x against their overall habit, 1.0 points per possession
- Clips: 0.0s to 13.2s, 376.8s to 389.8s, 450.8s to 463.4s

## Defensive lineup
- Simulation favours lineup 3 (RIV-03 RIV-04 RIV-06 RIV-07 RIV-09): 68.4 points allowed per 100, 22.7 better than the next lineup; chance it allows fewer than the alternative 8%

## What this report cannot tell you
- Shares come with intervals; a lift under 1.2 is habit, not a plan.
- Lineup estimates are shrunk toward averages because five-man units play few possessions; the raw plus-minus is shown beside them.
- Everything here is drawn from logs and one tracking record; the rules that name plays from tracking were right on about nine possessions in ten.
